description.value: Joe's on the Beach is a Canadian seafood restaurant in Sechelt, one of two landmark Joe's locations on BC's Sunshine Coast. The restaurant hosts events and offers catering alongside its regular dining service, making it a full-service coastal stop. For touring cyclists riding the Sunshine Coast, it sits in the heart of Sechelt and offers online ordering in addition to dine-in.
